title: Michael Jordan: The Last Shot
description: Finals pressure, clutch shots, and dynasty lore—a deep dive into the Last Shot.

questions.question: Which NBA player hit 'The Last Shot' in 1998?
questions.explanation: It was his 45th point of Game 6 of the 1998 Finals, clinching a sixth title and a second three-peat while back spasms hobbled Scottie Pippen.

questions.question: Against which team did Jordan hit 'The Last Shot'?
questions.explanation: A Finals rematch: Chicago had beaten Utah in six in 1997 too, the series of the "Flu Game." This time Utah's home crowd was one stop from a Game 7.

questions.question: Against the Utah Jazz, from whom did Jordan steal the ball before 'The Last Shot'?
questions.explanation: Jordan slipped behind him on a post-up and swatted it loose. A year earlier Pippen had whispered "The Mailman doesn't deliver on Sundays" before Malone missed two late free throws.

questions.question: After stripping Karl Malone, how much time was left on the clock for 'The Last Shot'?
questions.explanation: Jordan crossed over Bryon Russell, and fans still argue whether his left hand shoved Russell off balance. No call. Stockton's last-gasp three hit the front rim.

questions.question: With 5.2 seconds left, Jordan hit the shot—what did he do immediately after?
questions.explanation: Fernando Medina's photo of that pose became the image of the dynasty. The twist: it wasn't his last shot, just his last as a Bull. He came back with the Wizards in 2001.
